messages:
incident-bot: AUTOSCALER ALERT — prod-us-west inference pool reporting sustained throughput sag and queue growth. metric: live_qps down ~20% over 10m, tail queue latency rising. paging oncall.
jordan: on it. digging into pool metrics now. will post updates here. paging maya for capacity ops. @maya
maya: looking. seeing unusual KV cache eviction spikes on the mid-tier pods and a rolling restart earlier today correlates. onboarding scale-up now (adding 4 x reserved workers to pool). ETA ~8–12m. :hourglass:
sam: FYI seeing increased 5xx retries from model shard 3 and elevated GPU memory churn on a subset of hosts. I'm isolating those hosts from routing (draining) to reduce retry storms.
jordan: good call. start draining shard-3 hosts; switch routing to warm spare pool. toggling soft-throttle for non-enterprise traffic at edge to prioritize reserved capacity.
eli-cs: any initial customer impact estimate? want to know who to notify.
maya: rough: ~6–9% of hosted text-generation requests are seeing partial throttle + 3–8s additional latency; enterprise reserved customers currently within SLOs. affected endpoints are mostly high-concurrency chat routes.
jordan: tagging customers with >5% error-rate in the last 10m and preparing a short advisory.
ops-bot: ACTION LOGGED: incident-1923456789 created; severity: S3 (degraded throughput, partial customer impact). assigned: jordan, maya, sam. runbook: inference-throughput-degradation-v2.
maya: mitigation plan summary:
- step 1: add reserved workers (in progress)
- step 2: drain and reprovision noisy hosts (sam)
- step 3: enable model-fallback policy for chat endpoints (routes to smaller-quantized variant) for non-enterprise tiers
- step 4: keep prefix cache priming off for affected models until KV stabilizes
Expect visible improvement in 10–20m, full recovery target 30–45m depending on host reprovisioning.
jordan: posting draft status page message below — please review quick:

```Status: Degraded performance
We are investigating a throughput degradation affecting some hosted inference endpoints in the us-west region. Users may see increased queueing and elevated request latency. We are scaling capacity and draining affected hosts. No enterprise reserved capacity interruptions detected.
Impact: Partial for hosted API customers (approximately 6–9% of requests). ETA: mitigation in progress; expected recovery within 30–45 minutes.
Updates: will post changes here and on status.redwood.ai
``` 

maya: tweak: change "us-west" -> "prod-us-west inference pool" and add note about fallback.
jordan: updated draft and prepping to push to status page. eli-cs, please prepare customer-facing blurb for CS team. keep it short.
eli-cs: draft customer message for affected hosted customers:

"We are experiencing a temporary slowdown for a subset of text-generation requests in the prod-us-west region. Our engineers are scaling capacity and routing work around impacted hosts. You may see longer response times or intermittent throttling for a short period. We expect service levels to improve within 30–45 minutes. We will follow up when normal operation resumes. — Redwood Inference Status"

sam: drained 3 hosts from shard-3; memory churn reduced. rebalancing traffic now.
maya: reserved workers are up (+4). cold-starting model variants for fallback; will flip policy in 2–3m for non-enterprise traffic.
jordan: enabling soft-fallback now. monitoring key metrics.
ops-bot: METRIC SNAPSHOT (now): live_qps delta: -8% vs baseline, queue depth back to normal on drained nodes, 5xx rate trending down.
jordan: confirmed small improvement. leaving this thread to hand off to maya for ongoing follow-ups. maya is oncall for the next hour. handoff ts: 1923456800.
maya: taking over. I'll post a recovery update when we hit steady state. tagging @eli-cs for any customer replies needed.
eli-cs: will send customer pings to the affected list once we see stable improvement. thanks.
maya: RECOVERY UPDATE at 1923456845: throughput largely recovered, tail queue latency normalized. closing mitigation steps: keep fallback policy active for 15m, continue host reprovisioning in background. will mark incident as resolved after 1h monitoring with no regression.
jordan: thanks team. filing a follow-up postmortem ticket with initial action items (drain automation, improved KV eviction alerting, fallback policy rehearsals). :white_check_mark:
